details: Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded their largest monthly outflow ever in June, with investors pulling $4.06 billion. This surpasses the previous record of $3.56 billion set in February 2025. The last week alone saw $1.79 billion in outflows. Despite these significant withdrawals, Bitcoin's price held steady around $59,813, suggesting underlying demand absorbed the selling pressure.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Record $4.06 Billion Outflows in June

details: The People's Bank of China (PBoC) executed its first-ever overnight reverse repo operation on June 29, injecting 300 billion yuan (approximately $44 billion) into the interbank system at a rate of 1.25%. This move aims to enhance liquidity, particularly to smooth month-end and quarter-end funding fluctuations, thereby stabilizing the country's money markets.
title: China Injects $44 Billion into Financial System via Overnight Reverse Repo

details: The United States and Iran have agreed to a temporary halt in military strikes, allowing vessels to move freely in the Strait of Hormuz. While President Trump announced that Iran requested and would attend a meeting in Qatar, Iranian officials have denied any such talks are scheduled, creating uncertainty around ongoing diplomatic efforts.
title: US and Iran Agree to Halt Strikes Amid Conflicting Reports on Future Talks

details: Mārtiņš Kazāks, a member of the European Central Bank's (ECB) Governing Council, stated that the probability of negative economic scenarios for the eurozone has "fallen massively." His comments imply reduced concerns about further interest rate hikes, partly due to improved geopolitical stability in the Middle East.
title: ECB's Kazāks Sees Significant Decline in Eurozone Negative Scenarios

details: U.S. stock markets, including the S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial Average, and Nasdaq composite, are showing gains, recovering from a losing streak. The recovery is notably driven by AI-related stocks, following announcements of a substantial $520 billion investment by Samsung and SK Hynix in a new chipmaking hub in South Korea, aiming to capitalize on the increasing demand for AI technology.
title: U.S. Stock Market Rises, Led by AI Sector Recovery
